snippet.title: Unanswered | Act 1 - Teaser Trailer | Free Steam Game
snippet.description:
You wake up in your childhood home… but something is wrong. The silence feels alive. The rooms don’t remember you the way you remember them.

Unanswered is a first-person psychological horror experience where exploration, atmosphere, and story take center stage. No weapons. No escape. Just the weight of what you uncover.

Act I is just the beginning.

Wishlist now and prepare to descend.

#Unanswered #PsychologicalHorror #IndieGame #HorrorGame
